caption: The drawing features a central, ornate vase with an irregular, wavy rim, depicted in color. The vase is primarily white with golden yellow and brown accents outlining the edges and ridges. Its surface is decorated with hand-painted floral designs, including a prominent pink rose, green leaves, and smaller flowers in pink and purple hues. Additional gold detailing and patterns appear near the base and sides of the vase. Pink and red ornament-like protrusions are situated partway down the body, suggesting applied floral motifs. The base of the vase is flared and follows the same color scheme, with gold shading. Below the main colored illustration, there are three smaller, monochrome sketches in separate boxes, each depicting a different shape of ceramic object: the left is a vase with a wide, flared rim and narrow base, the center shows a top view of a shallow, ruffled dish or bowl, and the right displays a tall, narrow, twisted form similar to coral or tree bark. Each sketch is done in pencil or graphite and lacks color, showing only shading to indicate form and texture.
title: Porcelain Vase
